compatibility_class.reason: The v2 full-packet unit-ideal query becomes a monotone 13-row-group deletion surface with a fresh output namespace.

v2_results.required_verdict: COMPLEX_EMPTY with three-engine UNIT target consensus

solvers: msolve over Q, explicit expanded input without parentheses, two declaration orders
Singular characteristic zero, dp, std/unit-ideal test

case_matrix.monotonicity: UNIT is preserved by adding row-group equations

algorithm: Require both smoke controls to match on two msolve orders and Singular.
Replay the full packet in two fresh msolve processes.
Greedily try each row group once in fixed order, rebuilding two fresh msolve processes per trial; accept a deletion only on dual UNIT.
Replay the final candidate and every final drop-one in two fresh msolve processes and one fresh Singular process.
Claim inclusion-minimality only if the final candidate is three-way UNIT, every final drop-one is three-way NONUNIT, and no UNKNOWN occurred.
On UNKNOWN, retain the best independently authenticated UNIT subset, falling back to the exactly pinned v2 full set when necessary.

controls.known_nonunit: I=<x-y>; expected NONUNIT under all three runs.
controls.known_unit: I=<x,x-1>; expected UNIT under all three runs.

fail_closed_policy: Any timeout, nonzero return code, missing output, parse failure, variable-order disagreement, or cross-engine disagreement is UNKNOWN.
An UNKNOWN never licenses a deletion or a minimal-core claim.
The Singular budget is shared by controls and all publication replays and cannot exceed 300 seconds of measured solver wall time.
The permanent RUN_ONCE.guard is written before generated inputs or solver calls; generated files use exclusive creation.

post_wave_mine.scope: Only this wave's best authenticated retained-row table
post_wave_mine.outputs: Nonempty-support and at-least-two-support row-intersection graphs, including exact labels, components, degrees, bridges, cycle ranks, and deterministic fundamental cycle bases
post_wave_mine.forbidden: No Lean, theorem-bank, prior-wave, or literature search and no universal-theorem claim

trust_cost: Cross-engine exact computation only. No checkable Groebner certificate is emitted; msolve/Singular agreement remains trusted computation.
claim_boundary: No P97 counterexample, universal theorem, finite-to-universal lift, Lean theorem, or proof-spine closure.
